faq: Why start with the foundation?

Because every other stage sends people back to it. A clear brand, a website that converts and working tracking make every ad, post and review more effective, and stop you paying to send people to a weak first impression.
Do I need a full rebrand?
Rarely. Most businesses need clarity and consistency more than a new logo. We'll recommend the smallest change that fixes the problem.
Why are CRM and analytics part of the foundation?
Because every other stage depends on them. Without them, you can't follow up reliably or tell which marketing is working.
What is the difference between FirstBrand and FirstThought?

FirstBrand builds the foundation: who you are, how you look and sound, your website and the tracking behind it. FirstThought puts that foundation in front of the people searching for what you sell. A strong brand nobody finds doesn't grow, and visibility for a weak brand doesn't convert.

faq: What is the difference between FirstBrand and FirstThought?

FirstBrand builds the foundation: who you are, how you look and sound, your website and the tracking behind it. FirstThought puts that foundation in front of the people searching for what you sell. A strong brand nobody finds doesn't grow, and visibility for a weak brand doesn't convert, which is why the stages work as a system.
How long until I show up higher on Google?

Most businesses see map pack and profile improvements within the first 60 to 90 days. Competitive keywords and AI search visibility build over several months, which is why we pair SEO with ads and social for earlier results.
Do I need ads if I'm doing SEO?
Not always, but usually early on. Ads bring in calls while SEO builds, and they show which keywords convert best. As organic rankings grow, many partners shift budget away from ads.
What is AI search, and why does it matter?

Tools like ChatGPT, Google's AI answers and others now recommend local businesses directly. They pull from your website, reviews, profiles and mentions across the web. If that information is thin or inconsistent, you don't get recommended.

faq: What is the difference between FirstThought and FirstChoice?

FirstThought gets you found. FirstChoice turns the people who find you into leads and customers. Lots of visibility with weak conversion wastes money, and great conversion with no visibility has nothing to convert.
What is a lead magnet?
Something valuable a visitor gets in exchange for their contact details, like a checklist, guide, quiz or free estimate. It captures people who aren't ready to call yet.
How fast should we respond to new leads?
Within five minutes if you can. The first business to respond usually wins the job, which is why we automate the first reply.
Will automation feel impersonal?
Not when it's done well. Every message is written in your voice, kept short and handed to a real person when it matters.
